LibreCAD computer-use environment

earakely-scale/LibreCADComputerEnv-REA

Add four mounting-hole circles to a plate drawing in LibreCAD and save the DXF.

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal

verify.py reads the saved DXF through data/get and checks it now holds 9 circle entities; it does not check positions or sizes.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

pip install agentenv-framework==0.9.1431
hf download earakely-scale/LibreCADComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir librecad
agent-env run librecad/bundle --task add-holes --agent claude-code --model <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/LibreCADComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir LibreCADComputerEnv-REA

Needs: Docker; model provider configured for agentenv.

Evidence

3 of 3 Claude Code runs passed; the verifier failed before and passed after the scripted witness.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
